methodology_description: Historical observed resource-demand labels were unavailable. Resource-demand targets are deterministic impact-based proxies constructed from available disaster-impact variables and are intended for prototype/model-comparison purposes.

units.food_packets_demand: proxy food-supply packets (1 packet per relief-population person per relief period)
units.water_demand: proxy water-supply units (3 units per relief-population person; not litres)

formulas.relief_population: max(affected_population, evacuated_population); if zero and affected_families > 0: affected_families * assumed_persons_per_family
formulas.medical_kits_demand: ceil((injuries * medical_kits_per_injury + relief_population * medical_population_rate) * (1 + deaths * death_severity_indicator_weight))
formulas.shelter_capacity_demand: ceil(max(evacuated_population, houses_destroyed * shelter_per_destroyed_house + houses_damaged * shelter_per_damaged_house, affected_families * assumed_persons_per_family if relief_population == 0 else 0))

assumptions.relief_population: Uses max(affected_population, evacuated_population) to avoid double-counting when evacuated people are typically a subset of affected people. If both are zero, falls back to affected_families * assumed_persons_per_family.
assumptions.food_packets_per_person: Assumes 1 proxy food-supply packet per person in the relief population for one relief distribution period. This is a modelling assumption, not observed consumption.
assumptions.water_units_per_person: Assumes 3 proxy water-supply units per person in the relief population. Units are abstract supply units, not litres, unless explicitly converted in a future configuration revision.
assumptions.medical_kits_per_injury: Each reported injury contributes 0.5 proxy medical-kit demand units on average, reflecting that not every injury requires a full kit.
assumptions.medical_population_rate: A small baseline medical-kit demand proportional to relief population (2% of relief population) captures routine medical needs beyond recorded injuries.
assumptions.death_severity_indicator_weight: Deaths add a small severity multiplier (0.001 per death) to medical demand to reflect crisis intensity without treating deaths as surviving patients.
assumptions.shelter_per_destroyed_house: Assumes 1 proxy shelter space per destroyed house (household-level assumption documented, not observed occupancy).
assumptions.shelter_per_damaged_house: Assumes 0.25 proxy shelter spaces per damaged house, reflecting partial displacement.
assumptions.assumed_persons_per_family: When only family counts are available, assumes 4 persons per affected family for population fallback.
